title: Coaxial capacitor (electrostatics, analytic)
description:
Coaxial line cross-section: core (radius a) held at V0, shield (every cell with r > b) at 0 V, fill eps_fill.
Analytic: V = V0 ln(b/r)/ln(b/a), E_r = V0/(r ln(b/a)), C' = 2 pi eps0 eps_fill/ln(b/a) per m of depth.
Derived values tab: C_per_m (core charge / voltage), Q_shield (= -C' V0), W_field (integral of E.D/2 = C' V0^2/2) and V_mid (probe next to r = sqrt(a b), about V0/2) with their references; expect ~0.5 % from the staircased circles (one cell of radius is ~3.6 %; shrink dx_cell to see it converge).
Line profile tab: V_radial (field V) and E_radial (field E_x) from the axis to the domain edge against the analytic curves. Field tab: V and E maps.
Twin: coax_resistor_currents.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: core voltage [V]; the shield is held at 0 V

parameters.name: eps_fill
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of the fill (PTFE ~2.1)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: domain side; the shield fills every cell with r > b

parameters.name: x_c
parameters.description: axis x (a cell vertex, so the staircase is symmetric)

parameters.name: r_probe
parameters.description: probe radius: the cell centre just outside sqrt(a b), where V = V0/2

analytic_curves.name: V_radial
analytic_curves.expression: V0*log(b/min(max(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c), a), b))/log(b/a)

analytic_curves.name: E_radial
analytic_curves.expression: where((hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c) > a)*(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c) < b), V0*(x - x_c)/(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c)**2*log(b/a)), 0)
